questions.question_text: Which sport is the term 'Deuce' associated with?
questions.explanation: In Tennis, 'Deuce' is the score of 40-all in a game.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To beat around the bush'

options.B: To discuss a matter without coming to the point

questions.explanation: 'To beat around the bush' means to avoid coming to the point or to speak evasively.

Choose the word which is least like the other words in the group.
questions.explanation: All except Cow are carnivorous animals belonging to the cat family. Cow is a herbivore.

questions.question_text: Where is the headquarters of the Indian Air Force Training Command located?
questions.explanation: The Training Command of the Indian Air Force is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

questions.question_text: Select the synonym for the word: 'OBFUSCATE'
questions.explanation: Obfuscate means to make something unclear or unintelligible, which is synonymous with confusing.

questions.question_text: A can do a piece of work in 15 days and B can do it in 20 days. If they work together for 4 days, what fraction of the work is left?
questions.explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/15, B's 1 day work = 1/20. (A+B)'s 1 day work = 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60. Work done in 4 days = 4 * 7/60 = 7/15. Work left = 1 - 7/15 = 8/15.

questions.question_text: Which of the following diagrams indicates the best relation between Travelers, Train and Bus?

options.A: Two overlapping circles inside a large circle
options.C: A circle in the middle intersecting two separate circles on either side
options.D: One circle completely inside another, which is separate from a third

questions.explanation: Travelers (middle circle) can travel by Train (left circle) or Bus (right circle). Train and Bus are separate modes of transport, so they don't intersect, but travelers intersect both.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Indian to fly to space?
questions.explanation: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma, a former IAF pilot, flew aboard the Soviet Soyuz T-11 in 1984 as part of the Interkosmos programme.

questions.question_text: Identify the part of the sentence containing an error: Neither of the two candidates (A) / have paid (B) / their subscription (C) / No Error (D).
questions.explanation: The subject 'Neither of' takes a singular verb. So, 'has paid' should be used instead of 'have paid'. Also 'his subscription' instead of 'their'.
